title: Japanese Rice Bowl
description: A simple dish featuring Japanese ingredients, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Rinse the Japanese rice in a fine mesh strainer.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rinsed rice and 1 3/4 cups water.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
While the rice cooks, prepare the kissed rice bowl according to package instructions.
Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in soy sauce and sesame oil if using.
To assemble the dish, place the cooked Japanese rice into the kissed rice bowl.
